contradictions.fact: Icefall traverse direction (left vs right) to reach the main wall

claims.says: then traverse left across an icefall (reported as a genuinely exposed, 'frightening' crossing) to reach the main rock wall

contradictions.internal_resolution: approach_variants.notes and its baseFinding agree with each other (2 fields) against beta (1 field); 'right through the icefall' is more likely correct and beta's single-word summary is the outlier.
